$description: Color roles the semantic layer exposes. accent = the brand.config accent name used for the role (color.roles overrides it); seed = the color generated when no accent has that name; darkOffset = ramp steps toward light in dark mode.

presets.label: Primary
presets.description: Main action color: the brand ramp, or near-black / near-white when the brand is neutral.

presets.label: Destructive
presets.description: Irreversible or dangerous actions and errors. Never the only signal: pair it with text or an icon.

presets.label: Warning
presets.description: Something needs attention but is not broken. Amber usually needs dark text.

presets.label: Info
presets.description: Neutral, helpful information. Keep it distinct from the brand color.
